name.text: Relations Q6 - Tea farmers near Kericho delivering to one center

questiontext.text:
Farmers from four villages near Kericho, namely Kapsoit, Chilchila, Kabianga, and Ainamoi, all deliver their tea leaves to the very same collection center in Kericho town.

Treating the villages as the domain and the collection center as the codomain, what type of relation is this?

generalfeedback.text:
Here the domain is the four villages and the codomain is a single collection center. Every village connects to that same center, so many elements of the domain map to only one element of the codomain. This matches the definition of a many-to-one relation.

It is not one-to-many because no single village is being sent to more than one center. It is not one-to-one because more than one village shares the same center. It is not many-to-many because only one element of the codomain is being used. The correct answer is B.

questionvariables.text: options6: ["A. One-to-many","B. Many-to-one","C. One-to-one","D. Many-to-many"]; tans6: "B. Many-to-one";
